text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, as I'm walking by the plaza...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Halt, citizen! Have you seen any scary
bad guys
around here?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I'll... take that as a no. So another peaceful day... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hear me out! I'm suffering the worst
woes a hero
could feel right now!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I love peace, and of course I wish for it
from the
bottom of my heart...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: But I also really, really want to fight against some baddies! I wanna fight them and shout out my special moves while I'm at it!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I wanna have epic battles like a real
hero!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Awww, what? But my problem is that I don't wanna do that...
choice_data_list: We've got to save our energy.
Let's train while we still can!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I wanna look cool fighting, just like
Carrot
Ranger!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Of course not. She'd use up all her
energy if she
was in hero mode all the
time, so she's normally in
her
Umamusume form to—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I guess it's pretty important for a hero to
preserve
her strength too, huh!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, citizen, for teaching me such
a
valuable lesson!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying I should prepare for
future
battles?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Raaaah! Yeah! That sounds so cool! In
order to
prepare for battles, I've gotta
do some serious
training!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Like dodging tires careening down a
cliff! Or
chasing after Pop's car!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Relax, I won't go to such extreme
lengths.
Especially since Carrot Ranger
says not to do
anything dangerous
either!
choice_data_list: Kids, do not try this at home.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right! I don't have time to be
worrying over
something so silly!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta train so that I'm ready to take
on any
wrongdoer that appears! Thanks
for everything!
